reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Dispute ticket volume roughly doubled from a 590-610/month baseline (Jun-Jul 2026) to 1180 (Aug) and 1260 (Sep 2026) (E-06). The best-supported mechanism (H-BILLING-RULE-CHANGE) is that a change to billing import validation rules around that window introduced systematic bill errors in the "billing import + validation" step of meter-to-cash, affecting correctly-metered ACTUAL-read accounts as well as estimated ones: disputed bills skew toward ACTUAL reads (1785) over ESTIMATED reads (1240) (E-01), which rules out AMI/field read-delivery failure and estimate-substitution as the dominant driver, while tariff change (E-02) and slow dispute response handling (E-05) are also ruled out as causes.
